sources.title: MIT Finite Element Procedures, Lecture1: Some Basic Concepts of Engineering Analysis
sources.relevance: Linear elastic strain energy U=0.5*u^T*K*u; total potential also includes the load term -u^T*f, giving equilibrium K*u=f under the stated assumptions. Borrow the comparison to an expected response and a quadratic stiffness/precision metric. Activations have no supplied physical stiffness or physical mesh; choose/test a statistical surrogate explicitly.

sources.title: ANSYS Verification Manual, Energy Norm
sources.relevance: Element energy errors can be assembled into a global error energy norm. This motivates aggregating local computation inconsistencies, not calling raw activation norm mechanical potential energy.

sources.title: Rao and Ballard1999, Predictive coding in the visual cortex
sources.relevance: The primary abstract describes predictions and errors between expected and actual lower-level activity. Borrow conditional prediction error, rather than distance from one global mean. No assertion that Qwen is this cortical model.

sources.title: Friston and Kiebel2009, Predictive coding under the free-energy principle
sources.relevance: Hierarchical generative inference, recognition dynamics and precision-weighted prediction errors under specified assumptions. Our energy is a quadratic conditional-error analogue, not the full variational free energy with an explicit generative posterior/complexity term.

sources.title: Feldman and Friston2010, Attention, uncertainty, and free-energy
sources.relevance: State-dependent precision weights reliability of errors. Estimate uncertainty from whole-prompt-held-out BASE prediction errors; do not use optimistically tiny in-sample regression errors as certainty.

sources.title: Steering Awareness: Detecting Activation Steering from Within
sources.relevance: Prompt-conditioned Gaussian surrogate and precision-weighted matched filtering in Section3.1/AppendixA. Transfer depends on vector geometry; even the trained detector is not a generic arbitrary-direction anomaly oracle. Conditional/reference-based steering detection is established prior work.

proposed_exact_residual: For a trusted unmodified block F_l with the same full input/context/cache, r_l=h_observed-F_l(h_input,cache). E=0.5*sum r_l^T*P_l*r_l is zero for consistent computation up to a predetermined numeric tolerance and positive for a nonzero additive modification at an observed boundary if P_l is positive definite. Trusted pre/post boundary capture avoids recomputation. This is an engineering integrity monitor with explicit access assumptions, not inference of cause from an isolated activation cloud.
